title: Align the v1.0 product version and tag contract
description:
Every shipped component declares v1.0.0 and one checked contract rejects a tag or documented compatibility version that differs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: jit, jit-server, the MCP package, and the web package declare 1.0.0 in their manifests and committed lock metadata where applicable.
- [hard] REQ-02: The release version check accepts only the exact full tag v1.0.0 and requires its value to equal every product manifest value without a duplicated workflow version literal.
- [hard] REQ-03: Version tests distinguish product version from .jit repository format version and fail for a mismatched crate, package, tag, or compatibility declaration.
- [hard] REQ-04: CLI, Rust server/API, built web UI, and MCP server remain named supported v1.0 capabilities after alignment.

## Notes

Blast radius: Rust and Node manifests/locks, version-contract script/tests, and the one canonical compatibility declaration; no feature implementation changes.
